query.sql: SELECT uniqExact(ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id']) AS deployments FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_build_info' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND {{fleet}}
SELECT uniqExact(Attributes['version']) AS versions FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_build_info' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND {{fleet}}

SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS environment, argMax(Attributes['version'], TimeUnix) AS version, max(TimeUnix) AS last_seen, dateDiff('second', max(TimeUnix), now()) AS seconds_since FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_build_info' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY deployment, environment ORDER BY last_seen DESC

tiles.name: Tool call error rate by deployment

query.sql: SELECT deployment, kind, state, max(v) AS connections FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['kind'] AS kind, Attributes['state'] AS state, cityHash64(Attributes, ResourceAttributes) AS sid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_connections' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY deployment, kind, state, sid) GROUP BY deployment, kind, state ORDER BY deployment, kind, state

SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['backend'] AS backend FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_storage_backend_info' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY deployment, backend ORDER BY deployment
